quarterly_data.quarter: Nebius press release: Nebius acquires Inferize to strengthen Nebius Token (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nebius acquired Inferize, an inference optimization company (founded in January 2026) whose technology shortens the time needed to launch and scale large AI models (model cold starts), making inference workloads elastic so capacity scales more closely with actual usage; Inferize's technology and team joined Nebius Token Factory, Nebius's managed inference platform for production AI, starting with the integration of its technology. CTO Danila Shtan: Inferize will make Token Factory more responsive to customer demand and get more useful work out of Nebius's infrastructure. Terms were not disclosed.
